# I Found the Cutest Halloween Decorations on Sale at Amazon

Get up to 50% off floating candles, life-sized skeletons, and ceramic pumpkins.

By [Isabella Cavallo](/author/266084/isabella-cavallo/ "Isabella Cavallo")

We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our [review process.](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/institute/about-the-institute/a19748212/good-housekeeping-institute-product-reviews/)

Halloween is only a few weeks away, so it’s time to start adding ghosts, pumpkins, and skeletons to our homes and yards. If you want to shop for new items for spooky season, there are tons of [cute Halloween decorations on Amazon](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/holidays/halloween-ideas/g73346219/amazon-halloween-decorations-2026/) that’ll ship in time for October.
